description: Bounded behavioral mutations; native outcomes are recorded separately.

mutants.description: Accept an invalid zero-sized thumbnail instead of preserving the empty-data invariant.
Drop the four-channel pixel-count check; the truncated-data contract must reject the mutant.
Admit zero and 1000-pixel dimensions, changing the parser's documented range errors.
Invert invalid-extension handling so a BMP token is treated as a valid format path.

mutants.old:
for (size_t y = 0; y < data.height; ++ y)
        memcpy(rgba_pixels.data() + (data.height - y - 1) * row_size, data.pixels.data() + y * row_size, row_size);
mutants.new:
for (size_t y = 0; y < data.height; ++ y)
        memcpy(rgba_pixels.data() + y * row_size, data.pixels.data() + y * row_size, row_size);
mutants.description: Stop flipping QOI rows for firmware orientation; the red/blue two-row contract distinguishes the direction.
Ignore alpha premultiplication in BTT RGB565 conversion; the transparent-red fixture must retain black output.
Ignore the configured legacy default format; the exported JPG, QOI, BTT and ColPic paths must preserve the selected encoding.
Stop converting firmware-reserved RGB565 colors to black; the emitted BTT rows must retain the special-black mapping.
Ignore the ColPic transparent-pixel background substitution; the independently decoded RGB565 stream must retain the fallback color.
